text: DP-700's three domains map onto material you've already taken. A study plan here is a review schedule, not a first-pass-through-new-material schedule.

Domain one maps to Fabric Chapter 1. Domain two maps to Fabric Chapter 2 plus Databricks Delta Lake mechanics. Domain three maps to Fabric Chapter 3. Less learning for the first time, more drilling until it's automatic.

Week one: Domain 1 review plus the OneLake and Warehouse practice sets. Week two: Domain 2 review plus the Eventstream and Spark practice sets. Week three: Domain 3 review plus a re-read of the traps lesson.
Week four is both full-length mock exams under real time pressure, then two days re-reading every missed question — back to the original lesson when the gap is a concept gap.
If you have less time, compress weeks one through three — never skip the mock exams. Next up: exactly how to pace those exams once you sit down to take them.
